concept: Escanor adapts the historical Sunshine wielder during the period when the Grace is returned to him for the Demon King battle. His automatic attack is a Rhitta axe strike; the paths separately develop its rising strength, a temporary Sunshine peak, and precise controlled heat. These are proposed Tower Defense interactions, not claims of game execution.

signature.name: Sunshine
signature.adaptation: Escanor's Sunshine increases his size and strength through the day and reaches The One at noon for one minute. The plan represents these effects as permanent strength growth and a bounded manual boost, not a real-time day cycle or a guaranteed one-minute game duration.

repertoire.name: Sunshine
repertoire.limitation: Escanor's human body is harmed by continued Sunshine use in the cited period. The plan does not model bodily harm, and does not treat Sunshine as currently available after its stated return to Mael except when it is returned for the Demon King battle.

effects.effect: Sunshine increases Escanor's size and strength during the day.
effects.reason: Permanent axe damage represents increased strength; the proposal does not simulate time of day or body size.

effects.effect: Sunshine reaches a noon peak called The One, which lasts one minute.
effects.reason: The middle-path boost is named for and adapts The One, not Sunshine; the plan does not claim this effect for a purchase whose technique is Sunshine.

effects.effect: Sunshine radiates intense heat and light.
effects.reason: The plan assigns burn and area-hit adaptations to purchases named for other techniques, not to a purchase whose technique is Sunshine. Light and ambient heat are not represented.

effects.effect: Continued Sunshine use damages Escanor's human body.
effects.reason: Self-injury is not represented by the available attack promises.

repertoire.name: Rhitta
repertoire.limitation: Rhitta stores Escanor's radiated heat and can release it on command. The plan does not model heat storage, calling the axe, or an independent release action.

effects.effect: Escanor wields the heavy, off-balanced axe one-handed during the day and strikes with great strength.
effects.reason: The base attack is a normal-damage axe strike; top-path purchases develop its impact.

effects.effect: Rhitta stores and precisely releases Escanor's heat, with a wave of light and heat.
effects.reason: Stored charge and a separate commanded release are not ordinary attack mechanics or an available separate Active.

repertoire.name: Super Slash
repertoire.limitation: The source describes a powerful downward axe slash whose force is felt several meters away; it does not specify a repeatable area radius.

effects.effect: Escanor delivers a powerful downward axe slash that causes considerable damage felt several meters away.
effects.reason: The top path makes the heavy strike hit nearby enemies as a Tower Defense area adaptation, not a claim of a canon radius.

repertoire.name: Cruel Sun
repertoire.limitation: The cited passage describes a controlled miniature sun that grows when Escanor strikes opponents with it. The attack's delivery and target count are not quantified.

effects.effect: Escanor creates a miniature sun whose heat melts nearby armor and can be controlled to strike opponents.
effects.reason: The top path adapts its heat as burn; it does not claim that the cited passage establishes a splash area or separate miniature-sun delivery.

repertoire.name: Pride Flare
repertoire.limitation: The source describes a heat flare able to vaporize a sizable lake instantly; it does not establish an enemy status duration.

effects.effect: Escanor flares Cruel Sun with intense heat.
effects.reason: The top path represents heat with burn and a bounded area hit, not lake-scale effects.

repertoire.name: Crazy Prominence
repertoire.limitation: The cited technique produces many miniature suns that explode on impact. This plan does not add multiple projectiles or an explosive damage type.

effects.effect: Escanor produces many miniature suns that explode on impact.
effects.reason: Multiple suns and their explosive delivery are not represented; the area and heat adaptations do not claim separate suns.

repertoire.name: Final Prominence
repertoire.limitation: The One: Ultimate concentrates Escanor's power into a gigantic swirling fireball hurled at an opponent. The plan does not model its unique delivery or life-force cost.

effects.effect: Escanor hurls a gigantic concentrated fireball as The One: Ultimate.
effects.reason: A separate hurled fireball and its delivery cannot be expressed as a modification of the automatic axe attack.

repertoire.name: Daytime
repertoire.limitation: Daytime describes Escanor's changing body, demeanor, strength, endurance, and radiating heat. The proposal does not simulate daylight or change demeanor.

effects.effect: Escanor grows taller and more muscular as daytime advances.
effects.reason: Damage growth represents strength only; it does not simulate physical growth or time.

effects.effect: Escanor's heat can intensify at will.
effects.reason: Burn represents heat as a bounded Tower Defense effect, not ambient harm.

repertoire.name: Night-time
repertoire.limitation: This historical state describes Escanor becoming weak and unable to use magic at night; it is not a selected playable transformation.

effects.effect: Escanor becomes weak at night.
effects.reason: A real-time day and night cycle and its weakening are outside the Definition.

repertoire.name: The One
repertoire.limitation: The One is Escanor's one-minute noon peak. The game boost is temporary but does not synchronize with noon or reproduce invulnerability.

effects.effect: At noon Escanor becomes The One for one minute and his strength peaks.
effects.reason: The middle-path boost modifies the purchased axe attack for a bounded active window; invulnerability and exact canon duration are omitted.

repertoire.name: Divine Sword Escanor
repertoire.limitation: This is a hand swipe that cuts and can destroy Ominous Nebula. The plan does not adapt hand gestures or the specific interaction with that technique.

effects.effect: Escanor makes a downward hand swipe that cuts an opponent.
effects.reason: The selected base and paths use Rhitta, not a separate hand-delivered attack.

repertoire.name: Divine Spear Escanor
repertoire.limitation: This is a finger thrust with piercing force, not the selected axe attack.

effects.effect: Escanor thrusts his finger to pierce an opponent.
effects.reason: The bottom path's third purchase changes the attack to the documented finger-thrust delivery; this does not claim armor penetration.

repertoire.name: The One: Ultimate
repertoire.limitation: Escanor extends The One after noon by converting his life force into magic, eventually dying. It is not implemented as a second boost or as self-sacrifice.

effects.effect: Escanor spends life force to extend and enhance The One, at the cost of his life.
effects.reason: The Definition has no life-force resource, self-damage, or extension beyond the one purchased boost.

repertoire.name: Large Spear
repertoire.limitation: The cited source only establishes that Escanor briefly possessed a large spear ten years earlier.

effects.effect: Escanor possessed a large spear briefly in an earlier period.
effects.reason: No attack behavior is documented for this historical weapon.

repertoire.name: Magic Glasses
repertoire.limitation: The glasses suppress Escanor's daytime form and removing them triggers transformation. Transformation toggling is not part of this plan.

effects.effect: Escanor's glasses suppress his daytime form; removing them transforms him.
effects.reason: The Definition has no suppression toggle or transformation trigger.

base.name: Rhitta axe strike
base.behavior: At 0-0-0 Escanor swings Rhitta at one enemy in range along a clear path, dealing normal damage. Each strike has pierce capacity 2 including the primary enemy, shares that capacity across targets, and cannot hit one enemy twice in the same strike. No status or secondary target is affected.

path1.name: Sunfire Impact
path1.buyFor: Choose this path for heavy axe hits that can scorch clustered enemies and reach a bounded group around the selected target.
path1.weakness: The area effect has bounded capacity, and the path does not create miniature suns, fire multiple projectiles, or bypass blocked delivery paths. Its heat does not guarantee damage against a special enemy property.

tier1.change: 1-0-0 adds damage to each normal Rhitta strike against the selected target; its single attack and target capacity remain unchanged.

tier2.change: 2-0-0 adds further damage to each Rhitta strike against the selected target without changing its delivery or capacity.

tier3.change: 3-0-0 replaces the plain impact with Super Slash: each downward Rhitta strike damages the selected enemy and up to two distinct enemies near it, subject to the same strike's total pierce capacity; this is a bounded area adaptation, not a canon radius.

tier4.change: 4-0-0 adds a burn to enemies hit by the existing Rhitta strike and its splash. The heat effect is a Tower Defense adaptation of Cruel Sun and does not add a miniature sun or a separate projectile.

tier5.change: 5-0-0 increases the existing Pride Flare's bounded splash capacity and retains its burn on enemies hit by the Rhitta strike and splash. The impact remains limited by the strike's pierce capacity and does not vaporize terrain or create a lake-scale effect.

path1.capstoneValue: The fifth purchase develops the existing bounded area capability by reaching more distinct nearby enemies in one placement rather than only increasing damage or burn; repeated copies do not enlarge that placement's area.

path2.name: The One
path2.buyFor: Choose this path for a temporary peak that sharply increases the automatic axe attack's damage and frequency when manually activated.
path2.weakness: Only this path has an Active Ability, and its boost is temporary with a cooldown. The Definition does not model noon timing, exact one-minute canon duration, invulnerability, or the bodily cost of Sunshine.

tier1.change: 0-1-0 adds attack rate to Escanor's ordinary Rhitta strike at all times; it does not activate Sunshine or change damage.

tier2.change: 0-2-0 further increases the ordinary Rhitta strike's attack rate; the improvement remains permanent and adds no new delivery.

tier3.change: 0-3-0 permanently increases both damage and attack rate of the ordinary Rhitta strike, adapting Sunshine's rising strength and speed without a time-of-day cycle.

tier4.change: 0-4-0 unlocks a manually activated temporary boost to this purchased Rhitta attack: during its window the same attack deals more damage and strikes faster, then returns to its ordinary values. This adapts The One, without invulnerability or noon synchronization.

tier5.change: 0-5-0 permanently adds burn to the ordinary Rhitta attack and its inherited boost; during the same boost window it further increases attack damage and rate, then the attack returns to its permanent ordinary form. The burn is a Sunshine heat adaptation and is not limited to the active window.

path2.capstoneValue: The fifth purchase adds a permanent heat status inherited by the boost, so the concentrated investment gains an effect beyond larger active multipliers. It does not extend the boost or create a second Active.

path3.name: Measured Heat
path3.buyFor: Choose this path for greater reach and heat applied through precise strikes, while retaining the player's chosen primary target.
path3.weakness: The attack still requires a clear delivery path and has bounded pierce. Rhitta's stored heat, commanded release, and long-range axe travel are not modeled as separate actions.

tier1.change: 0-0-1 adds range to the ordinary Rhitta strike, which still attacks the player's selected primary target along a clear path.

tier2.change: 0-0-2 further increases the ordinary Rhitta strike's range without changing its target choice or delivery.

tier3.change: 0-0-3 replaces Rhitta's delivery with Divine Spear Escanor: each ordinary attack is a finger thrust at the player's selected primary target along a clear path, with increased range. Pierce remains hit capacity and does not grant armor penetration.

tier4.change: 0-0-4 adds damage and range to each ordinary Divine Spear finger thrust while preserving the player's primary targeting choice and existing shared pierce budget.

tier5.change: 0-0-5 adds burn to every enemy damaged by the ordinary Divine Spear attack, including enemies reached by its existing pierce, and increases its range. The heat is a Tower Defense adaptation of Escanor's controlled heat, not a separate commanded release or stored charge.

path3.capstoneValue: The fifth purchase gives the long-reach finger-thrust attack a new heat status on every eligible hit, making a single concentrated placement useful for applying heat at distance rather than merely increasing range or damage.

omittedTechniques.name: Crazy Prominence
omittedTechniques.reason: Its multiple miniature suns explode on impact. Distinct volleys or multiple projectiles could represent that behavior, but the selected paths do not purchase them; splash alone does not establish multiple suns.

omittedTechniques.name: Final Prominence
omittedTechniques.reason: Its gigantic swirling fireball is a separate hurled delivery. The Definition requires clear-path automatic attacks and has no separate ground-targeted attack, so damage or splash would not carry its defining delivery.

omittedTechniques.name: The One: Ultimate
omittedTechniques.reason: It extends and enhances The One by spending life force and eventually killing Escanor. The Definition has no life-force resource or self-sacrifice mechanic, and the plan does not disguise it as an ordinary boost.

omittedTechniques.name: Divine Sword Escanor
omittedTechniques.reason: The source describes a hand swipe that destroys a particular magical technique. The Definition has no technique-dispel or shield-bypass interaction, and the hand-delivered attack is not purchased.

omittedTechniques.name: Divine Spear Escanor
omittedTechniques.reason: The source describes a finger thrust with piercing force. Pierce is hit capacity, not armor penetration; this plan does not claim armor bypass. The bottom path adapts its finger-thrust delivery from its third purchase onward.

scopeLimits: The repertoire is bounded by the supplied passages and is not a complete account of Escanor's abilities.

The plan uses the historical period when Mael returns Sunshine to Escanor for the Demon King battle. Sunshine was otherwise returned to Mael during the New Holy War and remained with Escanor until his death after that battle; this proposal does not assert current availability.
All game actions and effects are proposed Tower Defense adaptations, not canon mechanics or proof of engine support. No prices or balance outcomes are asserted.

The Definition does not express real-time sunrise and sunset, noon timing, exact one-minute transformation duration, bodily harm, invulnerability, heat storage, a separate Rhitta release, or life-force expenditure.
All attacks require clear delivery paths. No obstacle bypass, enemy immunity override, armor-only damage, or special-property damage is granted.
